claims.citation: New York Herald, 31 July 1866, p. 5, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
The steamship City of Dublin, from New York, arrived
at Liverpool on the afternoon of the 21st of July.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 20 July 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Edinburg (Br), Halcrow, Liverpool July 4, via
Queenstown 5th, with mdse and 506[?] passengers, to John G
Dale. 13th inst, lat 49 48, lon 47 27, signalized steamship
Scotia, hence for Liverpool; same day, lat 48 37, lon 46 31,
passed three large icebergs; 17th, lat 42 15, lon 62 42, steam-
ship City of Dublin, hence for Liverpool; also a bark rigged
steamer bound E.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 160 miles E of Sandy Hook (July 8)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 10 July 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Manchester (Br), Jones, Liverpool June
23, and Queenstown 25th, with mdse and 809[?] passengers[?], to
John G Dale. June 28, lat 50 48, lon 19 14, bark Formosa[?]
(Port), bound E; July 8, 160 miles E of Sandy Hook, steam-
ship City of Dublin, hence for Liverpool.

Steamship Kangaroo (Br.), Manning, Liverpool July 12, with mdse.
nd 292[?] pass. to John G. Dale. July 14, 14 miles NE of Tuscar, passed
hip Jeremiah Thompson, from Liverpool for New-York; 17th, lat. 51
2[?], long. 22 08, steamship City of Dublin, bound E; 19th, lat. 50 36[?],
ong. 33 48, British bark Hornet, bound E; 21st, lat. 48 54, long. 44 11,
assed two icebergs; 22d, lat. 43[?] 15, long. 46 14, passed steamship
Cuba, bound E; same day, lat. 46[?] 03, long. 46 54, saw two large ice-
ergs; 25th, lat. 40[?] 24, long. 59 41, steamship Edinburgh, bound E;
8th, 85[?] miles East of Sandy Hook, passed steamship City of Paris,
ound E.
